q: How fast is EU free allocation phased out under CBAM, year by year?
title: CBAM free allocation phase-out by year
short: The CBAM factor that sets how much free allocation is deducted falls from 97.5% in 2026 to 95% in 2027, 90% in 2028, 77.5% in 2029, 51.5% in 2030, 39% in 2031, 26.5% in 2032, 14% in 2033 and zero in 2034. As it falls, more of each tonne is charged.
audience: Indian exporters and EU importers modelling CBAM cost from 2026 to 2034

p: Certificates owed per tonne equal embedded emissions minus the specific embedded free allocation. With default values, that allocation is the CBAM factor times the cross-sectoral correction factor times the CBAM benchmark for the good.

sections.h: Why 2030 is the step to plan for
p: The factor drops from 77.5% to 51.5% in one year. For a product near its benchmark, the cost per tonne can nearly double between 2029 and 2030 even if nothing at the plant changes.

senseible: Senseible reads coal, coke, gas, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so an actual figure you send an EU buyer can be traced back to the documents behind it. It does not file CBAM declarations.

sources.label: European Commission, Guidance No. 4, calculation of the free allocation adjustment (14 August 2026), Tables 2-1 and 2-2
